cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't sign yet. Our invitation says Friday; your booking says Monday. Which document needs correcting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The invitation. Monday saved a fortune. I've got to get to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A changed booking needs a changed invitation. Stay here while we establish who has the wrong date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone. I thought we'd tell them after you signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put the pen down. Before we correct their invitations, explain why you thought my signature could replace telling me.
